milestones.title: v1.2.0 — True-Scale Maker Baseline & Honesty Pass
milestones.targetEndState: Zero-surprise 1:1 millimeter STL and R12 DXF exports for 3D printing slicers and laser/CNC cutters, backed by accurate model IDs and transparent feature maturity documentation.
exitCriteria: Exported 10 cm CAD part measures 100.0 mm x 100.0 mm in Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, OrcaSlicer, and Cura
Header design switcher cleanly loads both custom designs and factory presets
Default cloud Gemini model IDs updated to verified production models (gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-2.5-pro)
Experimental AMD EDA Silicon Studio isolated behind an explicit opt-in toggle
All Vitest, TypeScript lint, and pytest suites pass with 0 errors

milestones.title: v1.3.0 — Precision Direct Editing, 3D Gizmos & Parametric Inspector
milestones.targetEndState: Users can click any part in the 3D viewport to drag/rotate/scale it with millimeter grid snapping or edit its dimensions in a live sidebar inspector without manually editing Python code.
exitCriteria: 3D TransformControls gizmo (Translate, Rotate, Scale) snaps to 1 mm / 5 mm / 15 deg increments and updates build_parts() code
Parametric Properties Inspector edits width, depth, height, radius, and position of only the selected part
mutateDimensionInCode() and applyCsgBooleanToScript() target exact part variables and support multi-line return [...] lists
src/App.tsx decomposed into modular UI components under 400 lines each

milestones.title: v1.4.0 — Structured Browser CAD Parser, Fillets/Chamfers & Fastener Library
milestones.targetEndState: Browser-only and macOS users can model functional mechanical parts with chamfers, fillets, and standard metric hardware cutouts (M2-M8 counterbores, countersinks, heat-set inserts, nut traps).
exitCriteria: Structured Python AST/block evaluator in cadRuntime.ts replaces single-line regexes and supports multi-line calls and helper functions
In-browser sm.chamfer_edges() and sm.fillet_edges() bevel/round geometry via manifold-3d operations
Metric Fastener & Hardware Catalog (M2-M8 clearance, SHCS counterbore, countersink, brass heat-set insert bosses, hex nut traps) produces watertight meshes within +/-0.05 mm of ISO tables
sm.sweep_along_planar_path extrudes along real 2D polyline paths instead of a hardcoded torus

milestones.title: v1.5.0 — Context-Aware Copilot (Click-to-Edit & DFM Auto-Repair)
milestones.targetEndState: The AI copilot understands which part, face, or vertex is selected in the 3D viewport and automatically enforces 3D printing and CNC Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM) constraints.
exitCriteria: /api/agent/turn receives selectedPartName, 3D surface/vertex pin coordinates and normals, and active DFM rules
Prompts referencing @part_name or active surface pins modify only the targeted feature without regenerating unrelated parts
DFM verifier flags thin walls (< 1.2 mm), tight mating clearances (< 0.25 mm), and unmachinable internal CNC corners (< toolRadius) with 1-click auto-repair
All 5 Canonical Maker Benchmark Fixtures pass automated synthesis and DFM checks

milestones.title: v2.0.0 — 2.5D Multi-Depth CNC CAM, Pocket Clearing & STEP / 3MF Interop
milestones.targetEndState: Machinists and makers can generate shop-ready 2.5D CNC G-code (multi-Z roughing, concentric/raster pocket clearing, peck drilling, dogbone corner relief) and export multi-part .3mf and .step files.
exitCriteria: Multi-Z planar slicing detects blind pockets, counterbores, stepped bosses, and through-holes across part height
Concentric and raster interior pocket clearing toolpaths respect configurable stepover (10%-80% tool diameter)
Circular hole recognition emits G81/G83 peck-drilling cycles and inside pockets support optional dogbone corner relief
Multi-part .3mf export preserves millimeter scale and part colors in Bambu Studio / PrusaSlicer, and Python backend exports ISO 10303-21 .step files

epics.title: [EPIC v1.2.0] True-Scale Maker Baseline, Model ID Standardization & UI Focus
epics.summary: Establish a rock-solid baseline for 3D printing and laser/CNC makers by shipping 10x millimeter STL scaling, accurate model IDs, clean preset switching, and an opt-in toggle for experimental non-maker modules.

epics.title: [EPIC v1.3.0] Precision Direct Viewport Editing, 3D Gizmos & Parametric Inspector
epics.summary: Enable clean direct manipulation in the 3D viewport and sidebar inspector so makers can position, resize, and boolean-combine parts visually with bi-directional Python code synchronization.

epics.title: [EPIC v1.4.0] Structured Browser CAD Parser, Fillets/Chamfers & Metric Fastener Catalog
epics.summary: Eliminate single-line regex limitations in the browser CAD evaluator and add real chamfer/fillet approximations, path sweeps, and a standard M2-M8 metric hardware and heat-set insert library.

epics.title: [EPIC v1.5.0] Context-Aware Copilot (Selection Pinning, @Part Targeting & DFM Loop)
epics.summary: Connect 3D viewport selection and surface/vertex annotation pins directly to the AI copilot and enforce automated Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM) rules for 3D printers and CNC mills.

epics.title: [EPIC v2.0.0] 2.5D Multi-Depth CNC CAM, Pocket Clearing & 3MF / STEP Interop
epics.summary: Upgrade the CAM studio from single-slice perimeter offsetting to full 2.5D multi-depth CNC machining (pocket clearing, peck drilling, dogbone relief) plus native .3mf and .step export.

subIssues.title: [v1.2.0] 10x Millimeter Slicer STL Scaling & Export Unit Toggle
subIssues.description: Add `unitScale` parameter (`10.0` for `cm` -> `mm` slicer standard, `1.0` for native OpenUSD `cm`) to `generatePartAsciiStl()` and `generateAsciiStlClient()`, expose `mm` vs `cm` unit selection in `CamCncModal.tsx` and the main export menu in `App.tsx`, and restore Factory Presets in the header design selector.
acceptanceCriteria: `generatePartAsciiStl(part, name, 10.0)` scales all vertex coordinates by 10x while preserving unit outward facet normals
Main export dropdown offers both `3D Printable STL (Millimeters 10x)` and `3D Mesh (Centimeters 1x)`
Unit tests in `cadRuntime.test.ts` and `CamCncModal.test.tsx` verify 10x scaling and UI controls

subIssues.title: [v1.2.0] Viewport Dimension Readout & Grid Unit Toggle (mm vs. cm)
subIssues.description: Allow makers to view bounding-box dimensions, grid spacing, and hover coordinates in **millimeters (`mm`)** by default in the 3D viewport and Mass Properties panel, while keeping internal OpenUSD `metersPerUnit = 0.01` (`cm`) compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Global display unit toggle (`mm` / `cm`) in the top viewport bar defaults to `mm` for maker workflows
Bounding box dimensions and hover tooltip coordinates multiply by `10` when `mm` display mode is active
Unit conversion helper is covered by unit tests

subIssues.title: [v1.2.0] Standardize Production Gemini Model IDs & Simplify AI Harness Catalog
subIssues.description: Replace placeholder model IDs (`gemini-3.8-flash`, `gemini-4-argon`) with verified Google GenAI model IDs (`gemini-2.5-flash`, `gemini-2.5-pro`, `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`) and consolidate duplicate AI harness options so every listed harness corresponds to a distinct execution protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: `server.ts` and `geminiAgent.ts` default to `gemini-2.5-flash` with fallback to `gemini-2.5-pro`
All tests in `src/services/geminiAgent.test.ts` and `src/server.test.ts` pass with updated model IDs
AI Harness modal clearly badges Cloud SDK, Local Ollama/vLLM Socket, OpenAI-Compatible Gateway, and Deterministic Offline Engine

subIssues.title: [v1.2.0] Isolate Experimental AMD EDA Silicon Studio Behind Opt-In Mode
subIssues.description: Keep the core workspace focused on 3D printing and CNC mechanical part design by moving the experimental 2.5D MCM Semiconductor Packaging Studio behind an explicit `Enable Experimental EDA Tools` setting rather than displaying it as a primary top-level workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Default workspace header prioritizes CAD Primitives, CSG Booleans, Overhang Inspector, and CAM/CNC & Slicer Studio
Experimental EDA Studio remains accessible via an opt-in toggle and passes existing `edaSiliconEngine.test.ts` suites

subIssues.title: [v1.3.0] Target-Scoped AST Dimension Mutation & Multi-Line CSG Boolean Parser
subIssues.description: Fix `mutateDimensionInCode()` in `parametricIntelligence.ts` so dimensional edits target only the variable bound to `intent.targetPart` (instead of replacing all cylinders/boxes globally), and fix `applyCsgBooleanToScript()` in `csgEngine.ts` to parse multi-line `return [...]` lists safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing the radius or height of `boss_cyl` in a multi-cylinder script leaves all other cylinders unchanged
`injectBoreOrPocket()` centers the subtracted bore on the target part's `(cx, cy)` bounding center and spans its exact Z height
`applyCsgBooleanToScript()` succeeds on multi-line formatted `return [...]` arrays with trailing commas and inline comments

subIssues.title: [v1.3.0] Live Parametric Properties Inspector for Selected Part
subIssues.description: Add a live **Part Dimensions & Transform** card in the right Engineering Inspector whenever a part is selected in the 3D viewport or parts tree, allowing users to type exact millimeter/centimeter values for `width`, `depth`, `height`, `radius`, and `[X, Y, Z]` position.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting a part populates numeric inputs parsed from its defining `sm.create_*` statement in `build_parts()`
Changing a numeric input immediately updates the Python script and re-evaluates the 3D mesh
Includes unit tests verifying round-trip UI-to-code dimension updates

subIssues.title: [v1.3.0] Interactive 3D Viewport Transform Gizmos (Translate / Rotate / Scale + Snap)
subIssues.description: Integrate `TransformControls` from `three/examples/jsm/controls/TransformControls.js` into `Viewport3D.tsx` so clicking a part attaches a 3D gizmo with Translate (`G`), Rotate (`R`), and Scale (`S`) modes, configurable grid snapping (`1 mm`, `5 mm`, `10 mm`, `15°`), and automatic write-back to `sm.translate()` / `sm.rotate()` or primitive origin coordinates in code.
acceptanceCriteria: Dragging the X/Y/Z translation handles moves the selected part smoothly while pausing orbit camera drag
Releasing the gizmo commits the new `[x, y, z]` coordinates or `sm.translate` / `sm.rotate` call into `build_parts()` and re-runs manifold/penetration checks
Grid snap toggle enforces exact millimeter/degree increments

subIssues.title: [v1.3.0] Decompose Monolithic src/App.tsx into Focused Workspace Modules
subIssues.description: Split the 1,700-line `src/App.tsx` monolith into clean, maintainable sub-components (`WorkspaceHeader.tsx`, `PresetAndFileSidebar.tsx`, `CopilotWorkbenchPane.tsx`, `EngineeringInspectorSidebar.tsx`) so contributors can work on UI panes without merge conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: `src/App.tsx` is reduced to under 450 lines of top-level state coordination
All existing Vitest and headless browser verification tests pass without regressions

subIssues.title: [v1.4.0] Structured Multi-Line Python Expression & Block Evaluator in cadRuntime.ts
subIssues.description: Replace single-line regex matching in `parseScriptBlocks()` / `executeSingleLine()` (`src/services/cadRuntime.ts`) with a parenthesis-balanced statement tokenizer and expression evaluator that supports multi-line `sm.create_*` calls, keyword arguments, nested `for` loops, `if/else` conditionals, and tuple unpacking.
acceptanceCriteria: Multi-line formatted `sm.create_box(...)`, `sm.create_cylinder(...)`, and `sm.boolean_difference(...)` calls evaluate identically to single-line calls
Variables defined via arithmetic expressions, `math.*` functions, and nested loops resolve accurately
Unit test suite in `cadRuntime.test.ts` covers multi-line scripts, keyword arguments, and nested loops

subIssues.title: [v1.4.0] In-Browser Chamfers (`sm.chamfer_edges`) & Fillets (`sm.fillet_edges`) via Manifold-3D
subIssues.description: Implement client-side `sm.chamfer_edges(brep, edges, distance)` and `sm.fillet_edges(brep, edges, radius)` in `cadRuntime.ts` using `manifold-3d` cross-section offset/extrude beveling and CSG edge cutters so browser users see real beveled and rounded edges on boxes and cylinders.
acceptanceCriteria: `sm.chamfer_edges(part, part.edges(), distance=0.3)` and `sm.fillet_edges(part, part.edges(), radius=0.4)` modify the part's `Manifold` solid and reduce sharp 90 deg edges
Resulting mesh remains 100% 2-manifold (`output_manifold = true`) for 3D printing slicing

subIssues.title: [v1.4.0] Metric Fastener, Counterbore, Heat-Set Insert & Extrusion Catalog
subIssues.description: Expand `PRIMITIVE_CATALOG` in `src/services/csgEngine.ts` with parametric generator helpers for standard 3D printing and CNC hardware: `M2`–`M8` clearance/tap holes, ISO 4762 SHCS counterbores, 90 deg flat-head countersinks, Voron/CNC Kitchen brass heat-set insert bosses, captive hex nut traps, and 2020 V-slot mounting profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can select `M2`, `M2.5`, `M3`, `M4`, `M5`, `M6`, or `M8` presets in the Add Primitive modal and insert positive bosses or negative subtraction cutters
Generated dimensions match standard metric clearance and counterbore tables within `+/-0.05 mm`

subIssues.title: [v1.4.0] Real 2D Profile Extrusion & Path Sweep in Browser Kernel
subIssues.description: Replace the hardcoded torus fallback in `sm.sweep_along_planar_path` (`src/services/cadRuntime.ts`) with actual `manifold-3d` `CrossSection` polygon extrusion and path segment lofting/revolving so custom 2D sketches, L-brackets, and piped sweeps evaluate accurately in browser mode.
acceptanceCriteria: `sm.sweep_along_planar_path` follows the actual path vertices supplied in the Python script
Closed 2D polygon profiles extrude into watertight 2-manifold solids

subIssues.title: [v1.5.0] Pass 3D Viewport Selection & Surface Pin Context into Copilot Turn API
subIssues.description: Extend `runAgenticCadTurn()` and `POST /api/agent/turn` to accept `selectedPartName`, selected part bounding box, and active 3D annotation pin coordinates/surface normals (`[x, y, z]`, `[nx, ny, nz]`), injecting them into the system prompt and offline parametric engine.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking a part or placing a 3D pin in the viewport displays a context chip (`@part_name` / `Pin [x, y, z]`) in the Copilot prompt bar
Prompting 'drill an M4 hole here' places the hole at the exact pin coordinate aligned with the surface normal

subIssues.title: [v1.5.0] Scoped Partial-Script Copilot Editing & Diff Preview
subIssues.description: Prevent LLM turns from accidentally rewriting or dropping unrelated parts in multi-part assemblies by locking non-targeted part definitions and offering a side-by-side / inline diff preview with 1-click Undo/Redo in the Python code editor.
acceptanceCriteria: Unselected anchor and component parts retain their exact code definitions during targeted copilot edits
Code editor includes an Undo/Redo stack (`Cmd/Ctrl+Z`, `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z`) across both manual and copilot edits

subIssues.title: [v1.5.0] Automated 3D Print & CNC DFM Validator in Copilot Self-Healing Loop
subIssues.description: Add deterministic Design-for-Manufacturing (DFM) checks to the copilot validation loop: minimum wall thickness (`>= 1.2 mm` for FDM), mating part clearance (`>= 0.25 mm`), unsupported overhang ratio (`> 45 deg`), and CNC minimum internal corner radius (`>= toolRadius`).
acceptanceCriteria: DFM warnings appear in the Diagnostics panel alongside Euler manifoldness and AABB penetration checks
Copilot self-healing loop automatically adjusts wall thickness or adds a 45 deg support chamfer when DFM mode is enabled

subIssues.title: [v1.5.0] Canonical Maker Benchmark Fixture Suite (5 End-to-End Parts)
subIssues.description: Add the 5 canonical maker benchmark parts defined in `ROADMAP.md` (NEMA 17 Stepper Bracket, Parametric Spur Gear, Electronics Enclosure with M3 Heat-Set Bosses, CNC Router Hold-Down Clamp, and Flanged Pipe Manifold) to the preset library and automated regression test suite.
acceptanceCriteria: All 5 benchmark fixtures build with 100% 2-manifold geometry, 0 unintended penetrations, valid 1:1 mm STL output, and closed R12 DXF loops in both Python `usd-brep` and browser `manifold-3d` modes

subIssues.title: [v2.0.0] Multi-Z Feature Extraction for Stepped Pockets, Counterbores & Bosses
subIssues.description: Upgrade `generateCncGcode()` and `buildSimulatedToolpath()` in `src/services/camService.ts` from slicing at a single hardcoded height (`z = 1.0 mm`) to sampling multiple Z planes at every horizontal face transition so stepped shoulders, blind pockets, and counterbores are machined to their exact Z depths.
acceptanceCriteria: Slicing a part with a 5 mm deep blind pocket and a 10 mm deep outer profile generates distinct Z-depth toolpath stages
3D toolpath simulator accurately renders multi-depth stepdowns

subIssues.title: [v2.0.0] True Concentric & Raster Interior Pocket Clearing Toolpaths
subIssues.description: Implement iterative inward stepover offsetting (`stepOverPercent`: 10%–80% of `toolDiameterMm`) and zig-zag raster hatching inside closed pocket contours so `inside_pocket` removes all interior stock material rather than only cutting a single inner perimeter ring.
acceptanceCriteria: Selecting `inside_pocket` generates concentric inward offset loops from the pocket center out to the final finish wall pass
Configurable stepover percentage in `CamCncModal.tsx` updates toolpath density and machining time estimate

subIssues.title: [v2.0.0] CNC Dogbone Corner Relief & G81/G83 Peck Drilling Cycles
subIssues.description: Add optional dogbone/T-bone overcut fillets at sharp concave internal corners (`addDogboneRelief: boolean`) so rectangular tabs fit into CNC-routed mortises/pockets, and emit `G81` / `G83` peck-drilling cycles when circular hole loops match the tool diameter.
acceptanceCriteria: Enabling Dogbone Corner Relief inserts tool-radius arc overcuts at internal 90 deg pocket corners
Circular bores matching drill/endmill diameter emit standard `G83` peck-drilling G-code blocks

subIssues.title: [v2.0.0] Multi-Part .3MF Slicer Archive & Backend ISO 10303-21 .STEP Export
subIssues.description: Add client-side `.3mf` XML/ZIP archive generation bundling all assembly parts, RGB display colors, and `unit="millimeter"` metadata for 1-click multi-color/multi-part opening in Bambu Studio and PrusaSlicer, plus `.step` / `.stp` B-Rep export when connected to the Python backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Exported `.3mf` archive contains valid `3D/3dmodel.model` XML with `<model unit="millimeter">` and per-part mesh objects
Python backend exposes `.step` export for exact NURBS B-Rep exchange with Fusion 360, FreeCAD, and SolidWorks
